d:
Nvidia is dealing with a crisis at the very top. The company's co-founder and former CEO, Jensen Huang, who stepped down last week following revelations about an alleged extramarital affair and a Chinese spy scandal, has publicly expressed his willingness to return. But Nvidia's board has firmly ruled out bringing him back. Samah Qundeel explains why the company is refusing to reinstate the man who built it into the world's leading AI chipmaker.
